verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes material from a public GitHub repository at github.com/ollama/ollama (README content on its REST API and integrations), which implies the source is publicly readable. No item states which license covers it or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open license (e.g. MIT/Apache), and first-party docs or independent corroboration that the full product source, including the desktop app and cloud parts, is published.
